description: Musical analysis of a recording in one call: key (e.g. "D minor"), bpm + per-beat tempo_map, meter / beats_per_bar, downbeats (seconds), sections (intro/verse/chorus… with times), chords (a progression on the beat grid), dynamics. USE THIS to learn the key and tempo of a reference before writing a part — never guess or ask the user for what the audio already says. Pass audio_key (an upload) or audio_url (a result URL from another job as returned, or any public https URL). Up to 10 minutes of audio is analyzed. Synchronous (~5–20 s): the result is in this response. No separation, so a dense mix's chords are a draft — for a chord chart from stems use doseedo_detect_chords on the separated stems. Cancel: not applicable — the result is returned in the submit response; the job is already finished.

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/"). Provide this or audio_url.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio (a doseedo result URL as returned, or any public URL). Alternative to audio_key.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

name: doseedo_analyze_song
